entities.summary: Zachary Aston-Reese is an American professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Cleveland Monsters of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League (NHL). He previously played with the Pittsburgh Penguins, Anaheim Ducks, Toronto Maple Leafs, and Detroit Red Wings.
